description: This source file implements ASN.1 TIME object handling functions, including creation, cloning, copying, comparison, encoding, decoding, and printing of ASN.1 time objects (UniversalTime and GeneralizedTime). It provides functionalities to manage ASN.1 time data structures, support encoding/decoding per ASN.1 DER rules, and perform time comparisons and value access.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_ALTIME
classes.description: The data structure representing ASN.1 time objects, including universal time and generalized time, with attributes for time value, type, name, class name, optional state, and attribute list.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1TimeCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ULONG uTimeType)
methods.description: Factory function that creates either a UniversalTime or GeneralizedTime ASN.1 object based on the uTimeType parameter.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1UniversalTimeCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext)
methods.description: Constructs an ASN.1 UniversalTime object with initialized attributes.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1GeneralizedTimeCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext)
methods.description: Constructs an ASN.1 GeneralizedTime object with initialized attributes.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscAsn1TimeInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the ASN.1 time object, setting function pointers for cloning, copying, comparison, encoding, decoding, dump, and readiness checks, as well as resetting the time value.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1TimeClone(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ASN.1 time object.

methods.name: BOOLEAN AnscAsn1TimeCopyTo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hDestObject)
methods.description: Copies the value of one ASN.1 time object to another.

methods.name: BOOLEAN AnscAsn1TimeEqualsTo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hOtherObject,BOOLEAN bValueOnly)
methods.description: Checks if two ASN.1 time objects have the same type, attributes, and value.

methods.name: LONG AnscAsn1TimeGetSizeOfEncoded(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Calculates the size needed to encode the ASN.1 time object in DER encoding.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscAsn1TimeDecodingData(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID * ppEncoding)
methods.description: Decodes ASN.1-encoded time data into the ASN.1 time object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscAsn1TimeEncodingData(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID * ppEncoding)
methods.description: Encodes the ASN.1 time object into DER binary format.

methods.name: BOOLEAN AnscAsn1TimeDumpObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PCHAR pBuffer,PULONG pLength,BOOLEAN bIsRoot,BOOLEAN bShowValue)
methods.description: Produces a string representation of the ASN.1 time object for debugging or display.

methods.name: BOOLEAN AnscAsn1TimeTraceObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,LONG layer,BOOLEAN bShowValue,BOOLEAN bRecursive)
methods.description: Prints a human-readable trace of the ASN.1 time object, including its attributes and value.

methods.name: BOOLEAN AnscAsn1TimeReadyToEncode(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Checks whether the ASN.1 time object has valid and sufficient data to be encoded.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscAsn1TimeGetTimeValue(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PULONG pYear,PULONG pMonth,PULONG pDay,PULONG pHour,PULONG pMinute,PULONG pSecond)
methods.description: Retrieves the individual components (year, month, day, hour, minute, second) of the ASN.1 time.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscAsn1TimeSetTimeValue(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG uYear,ULONG uMonth,ULONG uDay,ULONG uHour,ULONG uMinute,ULONG uSecond)
methods.description: Sets the individual components (year, month, day, hour, minute, second) for the ASN.1 time.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscAsn1TimeSetUniversalTime(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_UNIVERSAL_TIME uniTime)
methods.description: Sets the ASN.1 time value based on a universal time structure.

methods.name: BOOLEAN AnscAsn1TimeIsBefore(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG uYear,ULONG uMonth,ULONG uDay,ULONG uHour,ULONG uMinute,ULONG uSecond)
methods.description: Checks if the ASN.1 time is before a specific given time.

methods.name: BOOLEAN AnscAsn1TimeIsAfter(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG uYear,ULONG uMonth,ULONG uDay,ULONG uHour,ULONG uMinute,ULONG uSecond)
methods.description: Checks if the ASN.1 time is after a specific given time.
